name: 牛一碗 Lanzhou Beef Noodles
reviews: The service is unprofessional, staffs have bad attitudes, and the food quality is unsatisfied.

Love their skewers!! They were so incredibly juicy, perfectly seasoned, and every single bite was just bursting with flavor. Chicken wings and lamb skewer was the highlight
👍👍 definitely will be back for more.
If you're ever in Kingsford, you absolutely have to check out this spot. MUST try their skewers. They were perfectly cooked and seasoned, beef noodle was perfect cook with aromatic broth.
